lead.question: 为什么说准时是文明社会的必需习惯？小姑娘明明早到，又为何误了火车？
lead.warmup: 你是否有过“掐着点”出门、最终却错过班车的经历？在文明社会，准时是公共事务得以运转的前提；然而迟到令人厌烦，早到同样让人吃不消。本课从“太早”与“太晚”两个极端切入：一位小姑娘为防迟到提前赶到车站，却因忽略时刻表上一个微小的圆圈标记，眼睁睁看着火车进站又开走，被迫留在站台，实在令人心酸。
goals: 掌握 punctual / punctuality、platform、timetable、anxious、porter、adamant 等本课核心词汇。
理解并运用 only 置于句首引起的倒装句，以及 if / when / though 从句中主语与 be 的省略。
辨析 as much ... as、cut things fine、in good time 等短语，体会作者的对比与讽刺语气。
借助过去完成时 had impressed、虚拟语气 could not have made 与定语从句复述小姑娘误车的故事。
lead.summary: 课文先提出“准时是一切公共事务的必需习惯”，且早到与迟到同样使人难堪；接着以“赶火车宁可早到”作过渡，讲述小姑娘第一次独自出门的经历。她按父亲纸条提前二十分钟进站，却被搬运工告知早到两小时——原来那趟车到站时刻旁的小圆圈只表示停车装邮件、不载旅客。火车进站又开走，站长坚持“规章不能破坏”，她只得留在站台。
lead.tips: 诀窍：记住 as much a trial to others as the unpunctual 这一“as much + 名词 + as”比较结构，译作“和……一样令人难以忍受”；另注意 only 修饰状语置于句首才部分倒装，修饰主语则不倒装。

questions.q: Why did the young girl miss the train?
questions.zh: 那个小姑娘为什么误了火车？
questions.a: Because the train whose arrival time her father had written down stopped at the station only to take on mail, not passengers, so she could not get on it.
questions.aZh: 因为纸条上那趟车虽在那个时刻到站，却只停站装邮件、不载旅客，所以她上不了车。
questions.hint: 见课文第23句：a train did come...but only to take on mail, not passengers。

questions.q: Why does the writer say punctuality is a necessary habit in all public affairs in civilized society?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说准时是文明社会一切公共事务中必需的习惯？
questions.a: Because without it nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion; everything would be in a state of chaos.
questions.aZh: 因为没有准时，什么事情都无法完成，一切都会陷入混乱不堪的境地。

questions.q: What does the writer say about the guest who arrives half an hour too soon?
questions.zh: 作者怎样评价提前半小时到达的客人？
questions.a: Such a guest is the greatest nuisance; the over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual, so they were asked to come half an hour later than the other guests.
questions.aZh: 这样的客人最令人讨厌；到得过早的人和迟到的人同样使人无法忍受，所以作者只好请这些朋友比别的客人晚来半小时。

questions.q: Why did the porter say the girl was two hours too soon?
questions.zh: 搬运工为什么说姑娘早到了两个小时？
questions.a: Because the train listed on her father's paper did stop at that time, but only to take on mail, not passengers.
questions.aZh: 因为纸条上那趟车确实在那个时刻到站停车，但它只停站装邮件，不载旅客。

questions.q: Do you think the station master was right to refuse to let the girl get on? Give your reasons.
questions.zh: 你认为站长拒绝小姑娘上车的做法对吗？请说明理由。
questions.a: I think he was right: rules could not be broken, for one exception would destroy the very order that punctuality depends on. Still, it was hard on a young girl travelling alone for the first time.
questions.aZh: 我认为他是对的：规章制度不能破坏，破一次例就会动摇准时所依赖的秩序；不过对一个第一次独自出门的小姑娘来说，这也太不近人情了。
questions.hint: 结合课文末句 rules could not be broken 谈个人看法。

exercises.q: 汉译英：准时是文明社会中进行一切公共事务时必须养成的习惯。
exercises.a: Punctuality is a necessary habit in all public affairs in civilized society.

exercises.q: 句型转换：将 Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard it. 改为正常语序。
exercises.a: It is possible to disregard it only in a sparsely-populated rural community.
exercises.note: only 置句首引起部分倒装。

exercises.q: 填空：An even harder situation is to be on the ______ in good time for a train and still to see it go off without you. The girl asked to see a ______, but a tiny 'o' showed the train only stopped for mail.
改错：Her parents had impressed on her that it will be unforgivable to miss the train.
exercises.a: will 改为 would（宾语从句须与主句过去时一致）。
exercises.note: 主句过去时，从句用过去将来时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：姑娘确信父亲不可能犯这样的错误。
exercises.a: The girl felt sure that her father could not have made such a mistake.
exercises.note: could not have done 表对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: 用定语从句合并：Her father had written down all the details on a piece of paper. She felt in her handbag for it.
exercises.a: She felt in her handbag for the piece of paper on which her father had written down all the details of the journey.
exercises.note: 介词 on + which 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: 词形填空：1) The over-______ (punctual) can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual. 2) She was ______ (anxiety) to slip into the guard's van.
exercises.note: anxious=焦虑的；over- 前缀表过度。

quiz.q: 根据课文，准时对文明社会公共事务的重要性体现在哪里？
options: Without it, nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion.
It is only needed in sparsely-populated rural areas.
It can always be disregarded in ordinary living.
It matters only for dinner parties and appointments.

quiz.q: 在人口稀少的农村，人们可以怎样对待准时的习惯？
options: They must be held strictly to it.
It is possible to disregard it.
They can never be late at all.
They have to cut things fine.

quiz.q: 作者怎样看待那些爱“掐钟点”的人？
options: They are always lazy and useless citizens.
They are often more industrious, useful citizens than those who are never late.
They should never be forgiven by others.
They always arrive half an hour early.
quiz.note: 课文第10句表明作者的评价。

quiz.q: 作者家对爱早到的朋友采取了什么办法？
options: They ask them to come half an hour later than the other guests.
They never invite those friends again.
They tell them to come an hour earlier.
They secretly change the time of the party.
quiz.note: 课文第14句 half an hour later。

quiz.q: 搬运工为什么说那小姑娘早到了两个小时？
options: Because the train she wanted only stopped to take on mail, not passengers.
Because her ticket was for another day.
Because the timetable had been changed that day.
Because she had read the wrong platform number.
quiz.note: 那趟车只停站装邮件、不载旅客。

quiz.q: 面对小姑娘的央求，站长最后的态度如何？
options: He let her slip into the guard's van after all.
He was adamant: rules could not be broken.
He gave her a new ticket for the next train.
He offered to drive her to her destination.
quiz.note: 课文末句 was adamant, rules could not be broken。
